column1: # Whole messages as zbus 5.16.0 builds them, recorded 2026-10-16 for
# bus's answers (Hello, NameAcquired, AddMatch), org.a11y.Bus's address and
# property answers, the publisher's AT-SPI events, its answers to an AT, and
# The oracle: tests/recorder, described in zvariant-5.12.0-values.tsv. Each
# with every header field set through the builder and an explicit `serial(..)`
# (zbus otherwise draws serials from a process-wide counter), then
# `build(&body)`; the hex is `message.data().bytes()`. A body built from a
# struct (the Cache item) is its fields as arguments, the way zbus sends one.
# tests/zbus_messages.rs builds the same message by name.
